title: Flow progress
description: Execution progress of a declarative flow (the initialization flow, in M1): which stage is at what point and what it produced. The flow definition itself — purpose, participants, input documents, output schemas, skippability, blocking data — is a separate artifact (T-012); this one only records what happened. Validating a stage's structured output against its own schema is the flow engine's job (T-071), computing the blocking-data checklist is T-072's, and the legal order of transitions between stage states is enforced by the engine, not by this document.

flowRef.description: The flow definition being executed, as id@version against the global cache.

state.description: The stage state machine: pending, then in_progress, then pending_closure while closure extraction is retried, then closed or skipped as the two terminal outcomes.

participant.description: The flow definition declares roles for a stage; progress records who actually occupied each one.

stageProgress.description: One stage's execution progress within the flow.

allOf.title: A closed stage persists its artifact

id.description: The stage identifier within the flow definition.

outputRefs.description: The artifacts this stage produced when it closed.

closureAttempts.description: The bounded retries of structured-output extraction attempted at closure.
